comment: Single source of truth: every token id, its CSS variable, value, and why it exists. Edit here, not in CSS. Lint (scripts/check-tokens.js) enforces this file.

groups.description: Backgrounds and paper tones (warm cream family)

tokens.why: Primary warm paper; the whole identity sits on it
Alternate band (work section) — same family, one step deeper
Headlines and body on paper
Secondary labels; never for long body text. Value raised from #64716a for AA contrast on paper2 (5.42:1)

groups.description: Brand accents — each with a restricted role

tokens.why: Primary brand block color: buttons, map card, contact band
Action + attention: CTAs, kickers, links-on-hover. Never large fills. Deepened from #a85234 for AA contrast on paper2 (4.78:1)
Tiny craft accents only (seal ring, underlines). Never text on paper
Gold readable variant for use ON teal surfaces (map route, stops); base accent.gold #b18b51 fails contrast on teal

groups.description: The v10 night canon (decided 2026-11-06 walkthrough): dark stage surfaces. Paper tokens remain for workshop pages (workbench, notes essays).

tokens.why: Night ink ground of the stage (coin-study Night ink). The v10 canon page background.
Deep teal section band on the night stage (work band, feature bands).
Deepest night: footer and gradient terminus.
The near-black the sea photograph shades into; gradient overlays via color-mix keep it token-bound.
Soft glow tone for the D.I.C.E. radial; keeps the feature from reading as a flat fill.
Sail cream: type on the night stage (coin-study Sail).
Secondary text on night; carried from the cinematic draft, contrast-checked on night.base.
Brass: instrument, kickers, hairline accents on night (coin-study Brass). Text-safe on night.base at AA.
Borders and hairline grids
The voice: headlines + body
Labels/kickers only, never identity text

groups.description: Copy tokens — strategic claims, each bound to the strategy layer in site-content.js (SITE.strategy.contextTokens)

tokens.why: Ambition, with a bearing: commercial direction is the opening idea; it is not a quantified performance claim.
Marketing, direction, systems. The author does not claim an executive title he has not supplied.
Business leaders assessing judgement and the ability to carry a direction into coordinated work.
A shared direction makes priorities and decisions usable by the team.
Selected existing responsibilities; no invented commercial results or rejected personal cases.
